text: Artificial intelligence is a field of computer science that focuses on creating systems capable of performing tasks that normally require human intelligence.
Machine learning allows computers to learn patterns from data without being explicitly programmed for every individual task.
Deep learning uses neural networks with multiple layers to learn complex patterns from large datasets.
A neural network consists of interconnected computational units called neurons that process numerical information.
Supervised learning trains a model using input data paired with known target labels.
Unsupervised learning discovers hidden patterns or structures in data without labeled target values.
Natural language processing enables computers to understand, process, and generate human language.
Large language models are neural networks trained on massive text datasets to predict and generate language.
A transformer model uses attention mechanisms to learn relationships between tokens in a sequence.
Self-attention allows each token to consider the importance of other tokens in the same input sequence.
Tokenization converts text into smaller units called tokens that can be processed by a language model.
Embeddings represent words, sentences, or documents as numerical vectors in a continuous mathematical space.
Retrieval augmented generation combines document retrieval with language generation to improve factual responses.
A vector database stores numerical embeddings and enables similarity-based information retrieval.
FAISS is a library designed for efficient similarity search over dense numerical vectors.
Chunking divides long documents into smaller sections before creating embeddings for retrieval.
An AI agent is a system that can reason about a task, select tools, and perform multiple actions.
Tool calling allows a language model to request external functions such as calculators, search systems, or APIs.
LangGraph is a framework for building stateful workflows and agent systems using graph-based execution.
Fine-tuning adapts a pretrained language model to a specific domain or task using additional training data.
Full fine-tuning updates the parameters of the entire pretrained model during training.
Parameter efficient fine-tuning updates only a small portion of the model parameters while keeping most parameters frozen.
LoRA introduces trainable low-rank matrices into selected model layers to reduce fine-tuning cost.
Quantization reduces model memory usage by representing model weights with lower precision numerical formats.
FastAPI is a modern Python framework used to build high-performance application programming interfaces.
An API allows different software systems to communicate with each other through defined endpoints.
Model evaluation measures how well a trained model performs on data that was not used during training.
Overfitting occurs when a model memorizes the training data and performs poorly on unseen examples.
A validation dataset is used to monitor model performance during training and identify potential overfitting.
A learning rate controls the size of parameter updates during neural network optimization.
